shortDescription: Taiwan-listed printed circuit board maker Zhen Ding Technology Holding TWSE:4958 plans to raise $800 million through a five-year, zero-coupon convertible bond offering to fund working capital, according to a term sheet seen by Reuters on Tuesday.
